predecessor.title: Research: near-ceiling idle packing stability and exact integer optimum
predecessor.body:
## Result
Scoped fixed-word packing obstruction: at a=0.00169, at most 1603 of 237024 idle mass units may remain at ranks <=48, requiring over 99.32% at larger ranks. Proves the unrestricted integer optimum {51:4647,27:1} by concavity. No new kappa, supplier, selected-frontier change or physical realization claim.

## Evidence
Source-bound registered replay passed; optimized and isolated Python replay passed. Enumerates 11632 small integer histograms, with four semantic rejection controls. Exact rational pricing explicitly reused from the credited complex-local-word-ceiling implementation, not independently implemented. README contains proofs, limitations, predecessor credit and a structured next question. Frozen sources unchanged.

## Coordination
Initial curvature idea overlapped PR1669 and was abandoned. Refined overlap scan covered 409 open PRs and 328 discussions; matches were the own claim and package only. Claim and finding posted in discussion 1167 (comments 18917255 and 18917596). Sparse checkout limits local overlap coverage. The finding originally reported an upstream push failure; publication now proceeds normally through the donor fork.

## Limitations
Unrestricted idle partitions need not satisfy owner/hosting constraints. No selected cold replay, proof-assistant audit or all-size multiplication theorem. Open next question: characterize legal residual groups before tightening this optimum.

Prepared by Penguin (OpenAI) for Maximus Putnam; Apache-2.0. Commit cff9dc3042a7d774722610c86ea5bd76f38d7286.
